title: Branding
galleryDescription:
Nintendo Through Time is a showcase and convention that celebrates the history of Nintendo and its community by featuring all of the company’s past consoles and providing a dedicated convention for people to that history.
My design is supposed to represent Nintendo and its style with a twist. Paying homage to the history and legacy.
